task_statement: choose one joystick direction each step so the hero keeps producing the commanded displacement and keeps closing on the declared target, including after terrain or an enemy has blocked it or pushed it off the route
task_replaces: the R0 navigation-feedback task whose reward was the cue-derived arrival and whose only reference duplicated it
declared_goal_source: the versioned navigation contract bound by policy_bundle_sha256

signals.name: patch_displacement
signals.derivation: zero-mean normalised correlation of the background-subtracted hero patch between consecutive observations, no colour threshold

signals.name: commanded_response
signals.derivation: projection of patch_displacement on the unit vector of the direction actually dispatched for that step
signals.reference: the dispatched joystick direction recorded at dispatch time

signals.name: progress
signals.derivation: change in the distance from the frozen green-ring cue position to the declared target

signals.name: dead_reckoned_progress
signals.derivation: running sum of the per-step patch displacements, projected on the goal direction

signals.name: terminal
signals.derivation: declared tolerance reached on every target in order

independence.structural: the reward compares an execution-stream quantity (the dispatched direction) with a colour-agnostic image measurement (the patch displacement); neither authors the other
independence.cross_measurement: the cue-derived progress is compared with a dead-reckoned progress built from the patch displacements, so the two sides use different features of the same frames
not_independent: terminal against its own rule outcome
independence.duplication_guard: if the patch displacement is derived from the cue position rather than measured on the frame, the audit must fail
independence.forbidden: the same unvalidated detector must not both author a reward and prove its own accuracy

stop_conditions: response coverage below the frozen gate
positive response fraction below the frozen gate
per-step agreement below the frozen gate
per-axis mean bias above the frozen gate
any episode whose dead-reckoned net displacement differs from the cue net displacement beyond the gate
any reward component whose only reference is the same unvalidated detector
revision_reason: v1 established the structural independence of the commanded-response reward but its plain patch correlation carried a measured (-0.45,-0.85) px per-step bias because the static minimap terrain dominates the patch. v2 removes the static background by subtracting an episode background model before correlating, and pre-declares per-step gates plus an explicit per-axis bias gate so the diagnosed cause is judged directly.
